name: Flow-persistence regime gate on price momentum (daily, sustained inflow keeps you long)
rationale: MECHANISM: single-bar flow is noise (1-3d corr <0.3) but a PERSISTENT 7-14d net-inflow trend tightens correlation with forward returns (Neutralis; desks weight flows 15-25% only as a persistent trend). A sustained multi-day net inflow reflects a genuine slow liquidity regime shift (institutional/treasury demand building). Used as a LONG-ONLY regime GATE: take price-momentum longs (positive ret_Nd) ONLY while smoothed stablecoin_net_flow_usd is net-positive AND adx confirms a real trend; stand aside otherwise. Other side = anyone fighting a building liquidity tide. DISCONFIRMER: compare this gated momentum book to the SAME momentum entries UNGATED; if the gate does not improve DSR / reduce maxDD (never keeps you out of losing regimes), the flow persistence carries no regime information. Kill if the optimal smoothing window must be tuned per-asset — that is curve-fit, not a real 7-14d effect.
catalyst: price momentum confirmed by a persistent multi-day stablecoin inflow regime
